title: Unveiling aluminum diethyl phosphinate dual identity: Transfer from epoxy resins to glass fiber-reinforced composites
authors: Maria Jauregui Rozo; Sruthi Sunder; Weronika Tabaka; Benjamin Klaffke; Holger Ruckdäschel; Bernhard Schartel
source_version: Published original publisher indexed main text; PDF bytes and SI unavailable
TGA_instrument: NETZSCH TG 209 F1 Iris, Selb, Germany
TGA_specimen_preparation: Finished thermoset/composite specimens cryo-milled to fine powder to homogenize fiber content and improve crucible contact; 10 mg scanned from 30 to 900 °C under nitrogen 30 mL/min at 10 °C/min. Crucible material and replicate count are unreported.
source_material_form_TGA_raw: Source section 2.2 explicitly cryogrinds the thermosets and composites; section 3.1 explicitly assigns T5 to GF-BD specimens.
LOI_method: Measured limiting oxygen index according to ISO 4589-2; instrument unreported
LOI_specimen_preparation: 130 × 6.5 × 3 mm specimens conditioned at 23 °C and 50% relative humidity; duration and repeat count unreported.
source_numeric_evidence_description: Main section 3.1 gives each exact GF-BD T5; Table 3 gives measured LOI ±0.2 with the same source-native labels. No graph digitization.
conditions_locator: Sections 2.1–2.3 and Table 1 of the original publisher main text
TG_locator: Section 3.1, explicit GF-BD T5 sentence; method section 2.2
source_location: Original publisher indexed main text: complete sections 1–4, Tables 1–10, figure captions, preparation and methods, thermal and flammability discussion, conclusion and source references. Supporting DOCX remains unavailable.
washing_state: Initial manufactured laminate; no durability wash reported
source_T5_definition: Decomposition temperature at 5 wt% loss, section 3.1
treatment_method: DGEBA DER-331 (Olin Epoxy), dicyandiamide DYHARD 100S and urone accelerator DYHARD UR400 (Alzchem), with the resin blend ratio DGEBA:DICY:UR400 100:6.5:1. The source-defined formulated matrix is 70 wt% of that resin blend and 30 wt% aluminum diethyl phosphinate (Clariant), with no InSi or ZHS. SAERTEX bidirectional nonwoven glass reinforcement of 640 g/m² was processed through prepregs to 220 × 300 mm laminates in a pressurized autoclave. The full curing schedule, ply count and mixing parameters are not supplied by this original main text. Source-native LPS/HPS labels are retained because the product-size wording is internally inconsistent.
source_particle_size_conflict_raw: Section 2.1: EXOLIT OP1230 d50 2–3 µm, d95 10 µm; EXOLIT OP935 d50 20–40 µm, d95 50 µm. Later in section 2.1: LPS means low particle size (EXOLIT OP935), HPS means high particle size (EXOLIT OP1230).
source_TG_uncertainty_raw: Cryogrinding reduces uncertainty in glass fiber residue to less than 0.5 wt% and decomposition temperature to less than 1 °C; no row-specific SD assigned.
limitations: Two source-labelled AlPi laminates are represented by measured LOI and explicit main-text T5 values. The original publisher indexed main text is available; main PDF bytes, figure pixels and the supporting DOCX are unavailable. Source Table S1 is therefore not claimed reviewed. The main text distinguishes whole-composite TG from glass-subtracted, resin-normalized curves; the extracted T5 values are the explicit values assigned to the named GF-BD composites in section 3.1. No residue or peak is inferred from either curve. Table 2 component contents and total after pyrolysis remain unpaired, including a mismatch between the ZHS-row total and its listed components. Source section 2.1 assigns EXOLIT OP1230 to d50 2–3 µm and d95 10 µm, and OP935 to d50 20–40 µm and d95 50 µm, but then calls OP935 LPS and OP1230 HPS. Both statements are preserved without correcting the product or particle-size assignment; the source-native LPS/HPS specimen labels provide the assay crosswalk. The source identifies 220 × 300 mm laminates from 640 g/m² bidirectional nonwoven glass reinforcement cured in a pressurized autoclave, but this main text does not supply the complete curing schedule, ply count, mixing, cooling or storage history. Earlier related-paper conditions are not transferred. Cryo-milling is preparation of the finished composite for TG, not a precursor resin measurement. The source reports LOI ±0.2 without specifying its statistical meaning or replicate count. Generic TG uncertainty statements of less than 1 °C and less than 0.5 wt% are not encoded as row-specific standard deviations. The source observes violent gas expulsion and an unstable flame during some LOI tests and notes that this may produce high oxygen-index values; the measured high LOIs are preserved. The main prose adds OP to some LPS labels; the exact labels shared by Table 1, Table 3 and the T5 sentence are used. Later related papers repeat parts of this system and require sample-specific reuse review. No durability wash or post-fire TG/LOI pair is assigned.
sample_state: E70AlPi30LPS:GF-BD; initial bidirectional nonwoven glass/epoxy laminate
composition: Source-labelled 70 wt% epoxy formulation plus 30 wt% AlPi matrix; Table 1 gives (resin + FR)/glass mass fractions 28.0/72.0 wt%. Product-size identity remains source-conflicted, no correction assigned.
treatment_chemistry: Aluminum diethyl phosphinate, source-labelled LPS formulation
pairing_evidence: Table 1 labels the finished laminate E70AlPi30LPS:GF-BD; section 3.1 explicitly assigns T5 361 °C to that exact GF-BD label and Table 3 reports its measured LOI 73.8 ±0.2. Section 2.2 describes cryo-milling finished composites for TG, and section 2.3 defines the laminate LOI specimen. No pure-resin value or wash condition is substituted.
source_title: Unveiling aluminum diethyl phosphinate dual identity: Transfer from epoxy resins to glass fiber-reinforced composites
